depiction_rules.notes: D095 S003 only: Krishna's adult male friend listening to a teaching on bhakti. No historically verified portrait is available; keep the depiction dignified and generic rather than claiming a likeness.

visual_bible.face: Calm attentive expression, natural features, dark hair.
visual_bible.build: Ordinary human proportions, one head, two attached arms and two legs.
visual_bible.clothing: Simple cream dhoti and muted maroon shoulder cloth, with restrained ornaments only.
visual_bible.style: Flat matte South Indian temple mural drawing with firm dark contours and broad mineral color fields.

never: no readable text, labels or manuscript writing
no glossy skin or metallic gold
